subject: FallowTech onboarding: funding path activation & remit confirmation
messages:
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Accounts Payable <accounts@fallowtech.com>
Date: 2029-04-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: New vendor onboarding: bank details & PO preferences

Hi Cassandra / AP team,

Welcome — we're excited to get Fallow Tech set up in our payments system. To finish vendor activation on our side we need:

- A bank letter on company letterhead (payee name, account number, routing/IBAN where applicable)
- A completed W-9 (or W-8 if non-US)
- Preferred invoice PO field (external invoice number, project code, or Redwood PO)
- Remit format: do you prefer structured remit CSV or free-text remittance in the invoice body?

If you can send the bank letter + W-9 attached, we'll kick off micro-deposit verification and create the PO mapping. Targeting first pay-run the week after verification completes.

Thanks — please cc anyone else on your team who handles bank confirmations.

Best,
David Kim
Vendor Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Cassandra Lin <cassandra.lin@fallowtech.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-04-02T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding: bank details & PO preferences

Hi David — attaching the requested docs. See notes below.

Attachments:
- FallowTech_BankLetter.pdf (bank letter on letterhead)
- FallowTech_W9.pdf

Bank notes: ACH (domestic) preferred. Account is Fallow Tech Operating, last 4: 4321. If you need wire routing for international, the bank provided SWIFT: FARMUS33.

PO preference: we can accept Redwood PO in the invoice header — please include PO number in the invoice.number field.

Remit: structured CSV with invoice_id, invoice_total, remit_reference works best for our AP system.

Micro-deposits: our bank will expect two micro-deposits within 1-3 business days; will confirm when we see them and send the stub back.

Thanks,
Cassandra Lin
Director, Finance Operations
Fallow Tech, Inc.
accounts@fallowtech.com

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>

Date: 2029-04-03T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: FallowTech bank letter + W-9 (requesting micro-deposit schedule)

Jordan / Marissa — forwarding the bank letter + W-9 from Fallow Tech. They prefer ACH + structured CSV remits and will look for micro-deposits. Can Finance schedule the two micro-deposits (test debit/credit) to *******4321 and confirm amounts to Cassandra? Also please map PO handling so invoices with Redwood PO route to the correct GL.

Key items:
- ACH preferred, SWIFT provided for wires
- Remit CSV: invoice_id, invoice_total, remit_reference
- PO in invoice header

Let me know if you need anything else to complete activation.

Thanks,
David

1) Bank letter + W-9 received (attached to thread)
2) Finance will send two micro-deposits to acct ending 4321 later today; amounts will be randomized small cents (we'll confirm exact amounts in our reply)
3) Marissa: can you confirm remit CSV schema in our payments platform matches their requested fields (invoice_id, invoice_total, remit_reference)? If not, we'll add a mapping.

Cassandra — once we send micro-deposits, we'll reply here with the amounts. Please confirm within 3 business days so we can flip the vendor to "active-pay" and attach PO mapping.

Jordan Blake

- ACH routing verified (acct ending 4321)
- Remit mapping configured: invoice_id -> invoice.number, invoice_total -> invoice.amount, remit_reference -> invoice.remit_ref
